about: The English messages the Home story's people feature introduced (src/core/i18n/en.ts, people.*, #264), each with sample values. test/unit/i18n/moved-strings.test.ts asserts that the French catalog renders what the rewrite layer makes of the English. The Home card's hint stays English in French, as the layer leaves it: French would be a visible change for the owner to approve. The legacy panel still draws all of these until #266 and #268, so no entry of the rewrite layer is deleted yet. Deleted with the layer in phase 4.
